E1.description: true L = 0.8 L_nom (tolerance case) then +15 % drift between 60 and 90 ms; estimators start at L_nom

bayes.note: sequential grid posterior assumes a constant parameter -> it does not track the drift (reference only)

E1.bias_sources: AC loop resistance R_s = 0.3 Ohm (lossless regressor), ADC quantisation, gain errors of the v1/v2/i2 chains (fixed per unit, drawn from SENSOR); the modulator time quantisation (N_sub = 200 steps per period in the plant, 2000 in the C2000 ePWM) is removed by evaluating the regressor on the applied switching pattern

E2.description: steady state at 100/30/10 % load, true L = 0.9 L_nom, statistics over the last 2000 periods
E2.g_min_A_H: 2.5e-4 A*H (regressor threshold -> updates gated below ~25 % load)

E3.description: true Coss_er = 1.2 x datasheet, true L = 0.85 L_nom, 50 % load; transition-time sensor synthetic with 5 ns rms noise
E3.note: the Coss estimate inherits the L error one-to-one through I_edge; without the sensor Coss is unobservable (observability.json)

E4.description: loss steps 6 -> 14 -> 4 W per device; observer has +15 % RthJC and +10 % loss-estimate error; NTC noise 1 K
E4.note: Tj is not measurable; the error is dominated by the RthJC and loss-model errors, not by the NTC noise -> calibration need, see Multiphysics_Models
